tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dbang bshad mdor bsdus pa gcig pa bzhugs so// na mo mañju shrī nā thā ya/ 'dir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis/ sems can so so'i khams dang bsam pa dang / bag la nyal la dgongs nas dam pa'i chos kyi rnam par bzhag pa bsam gyis mi khyab par gsungs pa thams cad rigs su bsdus na/ theg pa dman pa dang / theg pa chen po gnyis sam/ pha rol tu phyin pa dang / gsang sngags kyi theg pa rnam pa gnyis su 'dus pa las/ 'dir sngags kyi theg pa yin la/ de la yang slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas rgyud sde gsum du bzhag pa dang / slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras kyi rgyud sde lngar bshad pa dang / 'khor lo bde mchog gsang mtha' ltar bshad pa'i skabs su rgyud sde drug tu bzhag pa sogs bshad tshul mang na yang / kye rdo rje'i bshad rgyud thun mong ma yin pa/ rdo rje gur las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /bya min rnal 'byor de ltag la/ /sems can mchog la rnal 'byor che/ rnal 'byor bla med de ltag la/ zhes gsungs pa'i rjes 'brangs nas/ rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams gsang sngags mtha' dag rgyud sde bzhir 'dus par bzhed pas/ bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa bzhi yin zhing / bya spyod gnyis la/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rigs dang 'jig rten pa'i rgyud gnyis/ dang po la de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs/ rdo rje'i rigs/ pad+ma'i rigs gsum du 'dus/ rnal 'byor rgyud la/ rtsa rgyud/ bshad rgyud/ cha mthun pa'i rgyud gsum/ /rnal 'byor bla med la thabs rgyud/ shes rab rgyud/ gnyis su med pa'i rgyud gsum las/ thabs rgyud la/ 'dod chags can gtso bor 'dul ba gsang ba 'dus pa'i skor/ zhe sdang can 'dul ba gshin rje gshed skor/ gti mug can 'dul ba rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i skor gsum du 'dus pa yin la/ shes rab kyi rgyud la rigs lnga dang /

rdo rje 'chang gi rigs te sgo drug tu 'dus/ 'dir gnyis su med pa'i rgyud bcom ldan 'das kye rdo rje rtsa ba'i rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud rdo rje gur/ thun mong gi bshad rgyud sam+bu ṭi rnams las mchog sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor brgya tham pa gsungs pa las/ gtso bor gyur pa snying po kye rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba la yang / brgyud pa'i bka' srol ḍom+bi ba'i lugs dang / mtsho skyes rdo rje'i lugs/ nag po dam tshig rdo rje'i lugs/ thun mong ma yin pa man ngag lugs bzhi las 'dir phyi ma ltar gyi dbang bskur ba bsgrub pa la/ rgyas par byed na/ dbang gi mngon par rtogs pa bdun nam/ brgyad ka tshang ba dgos la/ mdor bsdus na sta gon dang / dngos gzhi'i cho ga gnyis las/ dang po la/ sa'i lha mo sta gon/ lha sta gon/ bum pa sta gon/ slob ma sta gon bzhi las/ dang po gsum slob dpon kho nas sgrub chog pas sngon du song nas/ slob ma sta gon la chos bcu bzhi las/ dang po ni sogs rigs pas brtags la bya'o/ /rdo rje phur pa'i dbang byed na/ yang gsang sngags rnying ma'i lugs ltar na pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa la/ nyan thos/ rang sangs rgyas/ theg pa chen po dang gsum/ gsang sngags la phyi rgyud sde dang / nang gi rgyud sde gnyis las/ dang po la kṛ ya/ u pa/ yo ga gsum/ nang gi rgyud la ma hā yo ga thabs kyi rgyud/ a nu yo ga shes rab kyi rgyud/ a ti yo ga gnyis su med pa'i rgyud gsum las/ 'dir rjes su rnal 'byor ma rgyud la sgo drug tu gnas pa las/ phrin las kyi rigs phur bu rtsa ba'i rgyud rdo rje khros pa bi+i to ta ma la 'bum sde'i rgyud dam/ rig pa mchog gi rgyud kyi rdo rje rigs kyi le'u zur du phyung ba la rtsa ba'i dum bur grags pa ni rtsa rgyud yin la/ karma mā la/ las kyi phreng ba ni bshad rgyud kyi cha shas tsam yin pas de dag nas bshad pa'i lam gyi srol bstan pa snga dar la lugs mang du byung na yang /

'dir slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rdo rje las rim rtsa 'grel las 'byung ba bzhin/ dpal sa skya pa'i bka' srol rnam par dag pa'i tshul gyi rdo rje phur pa'i dbang la/ stod las byang chub sgrub pa'i dbang / smad las dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dbang gnyis las/ dang po la sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum/ sbyor ba la gang zag gi mtshan nyid/ gnas kyi mtshan nyid/ sa chog sta gon gyi cho ga dang bzhi las sta gon gyi cho ga la thig gdab pa/ lha sta gon/ bum pa sta gon/ slob ma sta gon rnams las/ sa'i lha mo sta gon dngos su ma bshad kyang / sa chog ma byas pa'i sar kha bskangs nas mdzad pas/ sta gon dang po rnams sngon du song ste/ slob ma sta gon las chos bcu gcig las/ dang po spro ba bskyed pa ni sogs bya/ kun rig gi dbang byed na/ rnal 'byor spyod dang bya dbye bas/ /zhes gsungs pas rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud kyang / rnal 'byor rgyud du bsdus nas bya ba/ spyod pa/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud gsum las/ 'dir rnal 'byor rgyud la/ rtsa rgyud bshad rgyud cha mthun pa'i rgyud las/ dang po ni de kho na nyid 'dus pa/ gnyis pa ni rdo rje rtse mo la sogs pa rnams yin zhing / cha mthun pa'i rgyud la/ ngan song sbyong rgyud/ gtsug dgu mtshan brjod/ dpal mchog dang po rnams su yod/ 'dir ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyud kyi brtag pa dang por/ kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / brtag pa phyi mar phyag na rdo rje thugs kyi dkyil 'khor la sogs pa/ dkyil 'khor bcu gcig byung ba las/ kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba la/ bod du yo ga stod lugs dang / smad lugs gnyis kyi dang po ni/ paṇ+ṭi ta dharmā phā la dang / shrad+dhā kā ra warma nas/ lo chen rin chen bzang po la brgyud de/ bla ma sa skya pa'i bar du byung ba'i dbang bskur ba sgrub pa la/ sta gon dang /

dngos gzhi gnyis sogs/ dbang gi bshad pa mdor bsdus pa las dang po pa rnams la phan pa'i don du dpal sa skya lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos dpal rgyun gyi dbang por bris pa'o/ /bla ma yi dam skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum/ /phrin las nyer sgrub chos bsrung nor lha'i tshogs/ /bden pa'i stobs dang dad pa'i nus mthu yis/ /myur du bla ma'i drung du mjal bar shog /ces pa 'di yang lo tsā bas mdzad// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sa lo chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ dbang bshad mdor bsdus dang smon lam sho lo ka gcig PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
